Introduction

Minsung is a South Korean singer-songwriter under ADVANTAGE.

He first debuted as a member of the boy group VARSITY, under the name Kid, on January 5, 2017, with the single "Round One". He was active with the group until their disbandment in April 2020. During his time in the group, Minsung participated in the survival show MIXNINE, where he was eliminated after ranking 48th place.

In September 2019, he performed as a member of RION FIVE, though his time in the group was short lived as he already seemed to have left sometime in 2020. Minsung then took part in the pre-debut group Ten-X in 2020, but left before their debut due to personal reasons.

He made his solo debut on January 31, 2022, with the release of the single "Tonight".
